def: properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) forsome heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor)

occurrences.text: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
